pattern_description: Two‑candle pattern: large candle in bias direction, small opposite candle with long wick covering >50 % of first candle.
Three‑candle pattern: two strong candles in bias direction, third small opposite with long wick.
Four‑candle pattern: three strong candles in direction, fourth small pull‑back (often inside OB) then continuation.
Eight‑candle range with low volume, small bodies, minimal wicks; forms A‑Zone (up) or D‑Zone (down).
conditions: Preceded by swing high (A‑Zone) or swing low (D‑Zone)
typical_use: Zone identification for later breakout or breakdown

pattern_description: Two higher highs and two higher lows (or lower lows) forming a mini‑trend.
Three higher highs and three higher lows (or lower lows) – stronger trend.
Four higher highs & four higher lows (or lower equivalents) – very strong trend.
Classic swing‑high/low analysis with Break of Structure (BOS) and Change of Character (CHoCH).
Single, very large candle breaking multiple swing points, often followed by short pullback.
Sharp move into liquidity pool (stop‑hunt) then immediate reversal; creates a “sweep” wick.
Tight range with low volume that later expands (breakout).

steps: Identify BOS (break of prior swing).
Look for pullback to nearest OB/FVG.
Wait for bullish/bearish engulfing or pin‑bar at that zone.
Enter in direction of BOS.
Place stop below (long) or above (short) the zone.
when_to_use: After a clear BOS and before the next swing.
typical_confirmation: BOS confirmed on higher TF; zone aligns with OB/FVG; reversal candle.
chart_example: EUR/USD 4‑h 2024‑06‑12 BOS 1.0825 → pullback to OB 1.0800 → long.

steps: Spot liquidity pool (cluster of stops).
Observe a sharp move into pool (sweep).
Wait for price to reverse and retest pool edge.
Enter on reversal candle.
Stop beyond sweep wick.
when_to_use: When a sudden stop‑hunt is evident.
typical_confirmation: Large volume spike; long wick into pool; reversal candle.

steps: Identify a valid Order Block.
Wait for price to break and then retrace to the OB.
Look for a reversal candle at that OB.
Enter in direction of original breakout.
when_to_use: After a strong breakout (e.g., after BOS).
typical_confirmation: OB aligns with higher‑TF bias; price respects OB on pullback; reversal candle.
chart_example: GBP/USD 4‑h 2024‑05‑30 OB 1.2600 → breakout 1.2750 → pullback to OB 1.2625 → long.

steps: Spot a Breaker Block that fails (price breaks through its high/low).
Wait for retest of the broken level.
Look for a pin‑bar or engulfing candle opposite to the broken direction.
Enter on that candle.
when_to_use: When a BB fails and polarity change is expected.
typical_confirmation: Retest of broken level; reversal candle; volume pick‑up.
chart_example: EUR/CHF 1‑h 2024‑04‑22 BB 1.0700 broken down → retest 1.0695 → short.

steps: Identify a partially filled OB (mitigation).
Observe price respecting the block again after a pullback.
Confirm with a bullish/bearish engulfing candle.
Enter in direction of the block’s original bias.
when_to_use: After an initial stop‑hunt that partially filled the OB.
typical_confirmation: Re‑test of block with low‑risk candle; volume support.

steps: Two‑bar pattern: first bar large in direction of bias, second bar small opposite with long wick.
Enter on close of second bar opposite direction.
typical_confirmation: Clear 2‑bar reversal shape; low volatility; often 5‑min.

steps: Three‑bar pattern: two strong candles in bias direction, third small opposite with long wick.
Enter on close of third candle opposite direction.
when_to_use: When market shows short‑term exhaustion after a move.
typical_confirmation: 3‑bar shape; volume drop on third bar; often 15‑min.

steps: Spot a massive displacement candle (breaks multiple swing points).
Wait for the first pullback (10‑20 % retrace).
Enter on pullback bounce using OB/FVG.
when_to_use: After a big “launch” candle that starts a new trend.
typical_confirmation: Large candle, high volume, break of BOS; pullback respects OB/FVG.

steps: Identify BOS and liquidity sweep within first 20 min of London/NY.
Wait for retest of sweep.
Enter on reversal candle before 20‑min window ends.
typical_confirmation: BOS, sweep, and retest all happen inside 20‑min.
chart_example: AUD/JPY 5‑min 2024‑06‑20 BOS 76.50 → sweep → retest 76.60 → long before 20‑min ends.

steps: Confirm same OB/FVG on higher TF (e.g., daily).
Drop to lower TF (e.g., 1‑h) and wait for pullback to same zone.
Enter on reversal candle on lower TF.
when_to_use: When you need extra confidence, especially in volatile sessions.
typical_confirmation: Higher‑TF bias matches lower‑TF entry; zone aligns on both TFs.

model: Sell Model A – OB Short Pullback
entry_trigger: Pullback to OB low after FVG fill → bearish engulfing
target_R_multiple: 62‑79 % retracement of prior up move or next BOS down
chart_example: EUR/USD 4‑h 2024‑06‑12 Bearish OB 1.0850, FVG filled, short @1.0845

model: Sell Model B – Liquidity Sweep Short after FVG
entry_trigger: Sweep down into pool → retest top of FVG → bearish pin‑bar
chart_example: GBP/JPY 1‑h 2024‑05‑20 Bearish FVG 156.00‑156.30 sweep down 155.80, short @155.85

model: Sell Model C – Rejection Block Short
required_confluence: Rejection block with strong bearish wick

model: Sell Model D – Distribution‑Zone Breakdown + Displacement
entry_trigger: Close below D‑Zone with strong candle
target_R_multiple: 2‑3 R or next major swing low

model: Sell Model E – Breaker Block Short Reversal
required_confluence: Bearish BB after failed bullish move
entry_trigger: Retest of broken BB high → bearish engulfing

model: Buy Model A – OB Pullback + FVG Fill
entry_trigger: Pullback to OB high after FVG filled → bullish engulfing
stop_placement: Below OB low (or below FVG low)
target_R_multiple: 62‑79 % retracement of move that created OB or next BOS

model: Buy Model B – Breaker Block Reversal after Liquidity Sweep
entry_trigger: After sweep, price retests broken BB level → bullish pin‑bar
chart_example: AUD/USD 1‑h 2024‑04‑22 BB 0.6600 broken down, sweep 0.6580, retest long @0.6595

model: Buy Model C – Mitigation Block Bounce + PD Zone
chart_example: GBP/JPY 30‑min 2024‑06‑14 Mitigation 155.20, PD 20 % discount, long @155.30, SL 155.00

model: Buy Model D – Accumulation‑Zone Breakout + Displacement
entry_trigger: Close above A‑Zone with strong candle

model: Buy Model E – Propulsion Block Momentum Burst
entry_trigger: Break above propulsion block high with large candle

definition: Institutional price zone of the last opposing candle before a directional move.
typical_confirmation: Alignment with higher‑timeframe bias; price retests block; BOS after retest.
ict_entry_technique: Pullback to OB after liquidity sweep → breakout of OB’s high/low.
ict_price_action_model: Foundation of the “Market Structure” model; used in OB‑pullback set‑ups.
common_mistake: Treating any support/resistance line as an OB.

definition: Three‑candle price gap creating an inefficiency.
key_characteristics: Middle candle’s high < previous low (bull) or low > previous high (bear)
typical_confirmation: Gap aligns with an OB; price returns to fill gap before continuation.
ict_entry_technique: Enter at edge of gap after it’s filled (2nd candle low for bullish, high for bearish).
ict_price_action_model: Core of the “Imbalance” model; combined with OB for high‑prob entries.
common_mistake: Jumping in before any price interaction.
chart_example: GBP/JPY 1‑h 2024‑05‑20 bullish FVG 158.80‑159.20 filled 159.45 → up to 160.10.

definition: Large area with little or no trading activity (often a gap).
typical_confirmation: Price typically reverses when reaching void; stop‑hunt may occur.
ict_entry_technique: Place stops beyond void; consider entering on opposite side after bounce.
common_mistake: Trading inside the void expecting continuation.

definition: Cluster of stop‑losses or large institutional orders that the market targets.
key_characteristics: Usually just above recent highs or below recent lows
typical_confirmation: Price moves into pool → sharp sweep → reversal.
ict_entry_technique: Enter after sweep when price retests pool and shows reversal candle.
common_mistake: Ignoring pool location or entering before sweep finishes.
chart_example: EUR/GBP 4‑h 2024‑04‑15 pool @ 0.8600, sweep down to 0.8570 → reversal up.

definition: An OB that fails to hold, flipping market polarity.
key_characteristics: Same visual as OB but price breaks through its high/low quickly
typical_confirmation: Retest of broken level with reversal candle (pin‑bar, engulfing).
ict_entry_technique: Short after bullish BB fails; long after bearish BB fails; entry at retest of broken level.
ict_price_action_model: “Breaker” in the ICT “Market Structure” model – signals reversal.
common_mistake: Treating BB as a normal OB and expecting continuation.
chart_example: AUD/USD daily 2023‑12‑08 bullish BB @ 0.6800 broken → retest → sell.

definition: Partially filled OB that still acts as support/resistance.
typical_confirmation: Price respects block again after pullback; a mitigation of earlier stop‑hunt.
ict_entry_technique: Enter on bounce off mitigation block with confirmation (bullish engulfing for long).

definition: The last OB before an explosive, high‑momentum move.
key_characteristics: Highest high (or lowest low) OB preceding strong breakout
typical_confirmation: Break of block’s high/low with strong momentum; continuation for several bars.
ict_entry_technique: Enter on break of propulsion block with tight stop below (long) / above (short).
common_mistake: Missing the block or entering too late.

definition: OB that shows immediate sharp price rejection on first touch.
key_characteristics: Strong candle with long opposite‑direction wick
typical_confirmation: Pin‑bar or engulfing candle rejecting block; volume surge.
ict_entry_technique: Enter after rejection candle closes, targeting next structure level.
common_mistake: Assuming block will hold and continuing in original direction.
chart_example: NZD/USD 4‑h 2024‑05‑10 bullish rejection block @ 0.6100 → pin‑bar up → move to 0.6180.

definition: Brief breach of swing high/low that fails and reverses.
key_characteristics: Small move into next zone, then close back below (bull) / above (bear)
typical_confirmation: Candle closing beyond swing high/low with reversal pattern; volume surge.
ict_entry_technique: Enter on reversal candle after SFP; use breached swing as stop.
common_mistake: Taking the initial breach as a breakout.

definition: False breakout that triggers clustered stops before reversing.
key_characteristics: Sharp, rapid move into pool of liquidity then immediate reversal
typical_confirmation: Large volume spike; wick into liquidity pool; reversal candle.
ict_entry_technique: Enter on reversal after sweep; stop placed beyond sweep’s high/low.
common_mistake: Chasing the initial move before reversal.
chart_example: EUR/CHF 4‑h 2024‑04‑28 sweep down to 1.0500 (pool) → reversal up to 1.0535.

definition: Series of swing points (HH/HL) + BOS/CHoCH that define market direction.
typical_confirmation: BOS confirmed on higher timeframe; price closes beyond swing point.
ict_entry_technique: Pullback after BOS → entry using OB/FVG for confluence.
ict_price_action_model: Core of all ICT analysis – the “backbone”.
common_mistake: Mis‑labeling swing points; ignoring higher‑timeframe bias.

definition: High‑probability time windows aligned with major market sessions.
typical_confirmation: Volume spikes; larger candle bodies; frequent BOS.
ict_entry_technique: Trade only inside kill zones; combine with OB/FVG confluence.
chart_example: EUR/USD 1‑h 2024‑07‑12 strong move at 07:30 GMT (London Open).

definition: 20‑minute precision window (first 20 min of London/NY) for high‑prob setups.
typical_confirmation: BOS → sweep → retest within the 20‑min window.
ict_entry_technique: Enter on retest after sweep inside 20‑min window; stop just beyond sweep.
ict_price_action_model: Very tight timing – must be watching chart.
common_mistake: Missing window or entering after it closes.
chart_example: AUD/JPY 5‑min 2024‑06‑20 BOS 76.50 00:05 GMT → sweep → retest 00:22 GMT.

definition: 3‑phase cycle: Accumulation → Manipulation → Trend (or Distribution → Manipulation → Trend).
typical_confirmation: Consolidation → breakout with volume surge.
ict_entry_technique: Enter at breakout of manipulation into trend; confirm with OB/FVG.
ict_price_action_model: Core cycle framework for ICT analysis.
common_mistake: Skipping manipulation and entering too early.

definition: Institutional Accumulation → Manipulation → Distribution phases.
key_characteristics: Distribution swing; mirrored in swing points
typical_confirmation: Sharp move (manipulation) after range; followed by continuation or reversal.
ict_entry_technique: Enter during manipulation with OB/FVG confluence; exit in distribution.
common_mistake: Ignoring distribution phase → staying in losing trade.

definition: Tight range where institutions build positions (usually preceding bullish move).
typical_confirmation: Break of zone with strong candle & volume increase.
ict_entry_technique: Buy on breakout; stop below zone.
common_mistake: Entering inside zone without breakout confirmation.

definition: Tight range where institutions unload positions (usually preceding bearish move).
typical_confirmation: Break below zone with strong bearish candle & volume.
ict_entry_technique: Short on breakdown; stop above zone.

definition: Sudden, large‑scale move signalling strong institutional activity – start of new trend.
typical_confirmation: Follow‑up candles maintain direction; volume stays elevated.
ict_entry_technique: Enter on first pullback after displacement, using OB/FVG as support/resistance.
common_mistake: Chasing the initial move without a pullback.

definition: Footprint of large institutional trades observable via OBs, volume spikes, and imbalance zones.
typical_confirmation: Confluence of OB, FVG, volume imbalance on multiple TFs.
ict_entry_technique: Enter when price respects an OB that aligns with order‑flow evidence.
ict_price_action_model: Underlying layer for all ICT models – confirmation tier.
common_mistake: Relying on price patterns alone without flow confirmation.
chart_example: EUR/USD 1‑h 2024‑07‑05 volume spike 1.0820 coinciding with OB.

definition: Disproportionate buying or selling volume creating a micro‑inefficiency.
typical_confirmation: Imbalance aligns with OB/FVG and a price reversal.
ict_entry_technique: Enter on reversal after imbalance is absorbed.
common_mistake: Assuming every imbalance leads to reversal.

definition: Confirming a set‑up across two or more time‑frames.
key_characteristics: Same confluence (OB, FVG, BOS) visible on higher & lower TFs
typical_confirmation: Higher‑TF bias matches lower‑TF entry.
ict_entry_technique: Enter on lower‑TF pullback after higher‑TF confirmation.
ict_price_action_model: Time‑filter applied to any ICT model.
common_mistake: Ignoring higher‑TF bias; entering on lower‑TF only.

definition: Entry on a pullback to a key institutional zone after a breakout.
typical_confirmation: Reversal candle at zone + volume pick‑up.
ict_entry_technique: Place entry just above (long) / below (short) zone after confirmation.
common_mistake: Entering before confirmation or on wrong side of zone.
chart_example: USD/CHF 15‑min 2024‑06‑28 pullback to OB 0.9100 after breakout.

definition: Entry taken as soon as a key level (OB, FVG, A‑Zone) is broken.
typical_confirmation: Large candle, volume surge, break of BOS.
ict_entry_technique: Enter on candle close beyond zone; stop just inside zone.

definition: Deliberate move that hunts retail stops before resuming original direction (a subtype of liquidity sweep).
typical_confirmation: Volume spike, wick into stop zone, reversal candle.
ict_entry_technique: Enter on reversal after stop‑hunt; stop beyond wick.
common_mistake: Chasing initial move; not respecting reversal.

definition: Over‑arching methodology that trades with institutional order flow (OB, FVG, liquidity pools, market structure).
typical_confirmation: Multiple SMC elements aligning (e.g., OB + FVG + BOS + kill zone).
ict_entry_technique: Follow the specific entry technique tied to the confluence (pullback, breakout, sweep, etc.).
ict_price_action_model: Integrates all ICT models into a cohesive system.
common_mistake: Trying to apply SMC without proper confluence → low‑prob trades.
chart_example: Composite example – EUR/USD daily OB 1.0800 + FVG filled → BOS 1.0830 during London kill zone → long.
